coolant.name: 50 wt% ethylene glycol / water at 25 C baseline
coolant.sourceRef: F2 (Yaws / Engineering ToolBox 50 wt% EG correlations at 25 C; water check 4186 J/(kg.K), 0.603 W/(m.K))

parameters.name: NMC 4680 cell nominal capacity
parameters.conditionOrAssumption: Measured capacity from Table 1 (S1 notes 22.078 Ah variant on separate sample).
parameters.confidenceNote: Measured in S15; consistent with r_dc_nmc 1C reference current.

parameters.name: LFP prismatic cell specific heat capacity
parameters.sourceRef: F1 (Steinhardt et al. 2022) format median; +0.2%/K temp slope
parameters.conditionOrAssumption: Median of 52 full-cell calorimetric measurements by format at ~25 C.
parameters.confidenceNote: Prismatic LFP entries span 1048-1174 J/(kg.K); format median 1041 used cleanly with F1 +0.2%/K temperature coefficient.

parameters.name: NMC cylindrical cell specific heat capacity
parameters.sourceRef: F1 (Steinhardt et al. 2022) cylindrical format median; +0.2%/K temp slope
parameters.conditionOrAssumption: Median across cylindrical full cells; applied to 4680 cell mass 0.355 kg (S15/S1).
parameters.confidenceNote: Format median carries cell-to-cell spread; check P3 against S1 uncooled heating.

parameters.name: Cell through-plane thermal conductivity
parameters.conditionOrAssumption: Full-cell median across jelly-roll/stack layers; published spread 0.15-1.4 W/(m.K).
parameters.confidenceNote: +/-81% uncertainty reported in F1; sensitivity checked in M1.

parameters.name: 50 wt% ethylene glycol/water coolant properties at 25 C
parameters.sourceRef: F2 (Yaws / Engineering ToolBox 50 wt% EG correlations at 25 C)
parameters.conditionOrAssumption: Constant fluid properties evaluated at 25 C nominal inlet.
parameters.confidenceNote: Pure water check reproduces 4186 J/(kg.K) and 0.603 W/(m.K).

parameters.name: Laminar fully developed Nusselt number (a=8b rectangular duct, constant T_w)
parameters.conditionOrAssumption: Fully developed laminar flow (Re < 950 per F3, < 2300 general), uniform wall temperature conservative bound.
parameters.confidenceNote: Runtime flags NON_LAMINAR_COOLANT_F3 at Re >= 950 and TRANSITIONAL_OR_TURBULENT_RE at Re >= 2300.

parameters.name: Ambient natural convection coefficient
parameters.sourceRef: F3 (cold-plate EV pack thermal study assumption)
parameters.conditionOrAssumption: Constant ambient heat transfer coefficient over pack exterior surface.
parameters.confidenceNote: Study-specific assumption; pack heat removal is dominated by liquid cooling.

parameters.name: LFP zone-to-zone and ambient resistances
parameters.sourceRef: Derived from F1 k_perp, F3 h_amb, and assumed pack/TIM geometry
parameters.conditionOrAssumption: 10 zones x 12 blade cells; 1.5 mm TIM (3.0 W/(m.K)); 14 channels (24 x 3 mm).
parameters.confidenceNote: Assumed channel & TIM thicknesses dominate R_cc; documented as Assumed.

parameters.name: NMC 4680 zone-to-zone and ambient resistances
parameters.sourceRef: Derived from F1 k_perp, F3 h_amb, and assumed ribbon/TIM geometry
parameters.conditionOrAssumption: 12 zones x 69 cells; 1.0 mm TIM sleeve (2.5 W/(m.K)); 12 channels (24 x 3 mm); 60 deg arc contact.
parameters.confidenceNote: Assumed contact arc and TIM thickness.

parameters.name: LFP blade pack topology & cooling channel dimensions
parameters.conditionOrAssumption: 400V-class 120s1p CTP layout sized so 1-16 L/min sits inside Re < 950 laminar regime.

parameters.name: NMC 4680 pack topology & cooling channel dimensions
parameters.symbol: N_s x N_p, N_zones, a, b, N_ch
parameters.conditionOrAssumption: 36 x 23 upright cylindrical array with side cooling ribbons.

parameters.name: DC internal resistance tables vs SOC & temperature
parameters.sourceRef: S15 Figure 8 (18 s pulse resistance at 10, 20, 40 C)
parameters.conditionOrAssumption: Bilinear lookup across SOC 20-90% and T 10-40 C, clamped at grid boundaries with out-of-range warnings.
parameters.confidenceNote: Overlay verified pixel-accurate; Panel C 1C 20 C cross-check within +/-0.05 mOhm.

parameters.name: Open-circuit voltage & entropic coefficient proxy tables
parameters.sourceRef: F7 Figs. 2 & 3 (26650 LFP & 21700 NMC proxy cells); F8 qualitative NMC check
parameters.conditionOrAssumption: Proxy chemistry curves applied to blade LFP and 4680 NMC.
parameters.confidenceNote: Exact PDF vector coordinates; explicitly labelled PROXY CELL.

parameters.name: LFP semi-empirical calendar & cycle capacity-loss parameters
parameters.unit: Schimpe 2018 Table IV SI / h^-0.5 / Ah^-0.5 / Ah^-1
parameters.sourceRef: F9 (Schimpe et al. 2018, JES 165 A181-A193, Table IV, Eqs. 9-23 & A1-A2)
parameters.conditionOrAssumption: Fitted on Sony US26650FTC1 3 Ah LFP cell; scaled to arbitrary pack via FEC and C-rate ratio.
parameters.confidenceNote: Illustrative proxy (26650 LFP cell, not 135 Ah blade cell). NMC uses Option B user-editable inputs with no defaults.
